description: Import the user's trace file (GPX, TCX, IGC, SBP or FIT, max 8 MiB) into THEIR SportsTrackLive account permanently — full analysis, 3D replay, appears in their profile with their default privacy setting. REQUIRES the user to be connected via OAuth (this MCP server supports it; the client starts the flow). For a user without an account, use create_ephemeral_replay instead. Send the file through exactly one of `file_url` (public https link), `upload_id` or `file_base64` (small files; gzip accepted) — same routes as analyze_activity_file. If you cannot upload it yourself, call `create_upload_link`, have the user drop the file on the returned page, then pass its `upload_id` here.

SportKind.description:
Sport declared by the calling agent. `Auto` lets the server guess from
the file format and the trace kinematics; the resolved value is returned
in `context_used` so the agent can correct it and call again.

file_base64.description: Same three sources as analyze_activity_file — provide exactly one.

sport.description: Sport of the activity — selects the analysis profile.

name: import_activity
